retryMax.description:
If it's zero, the agent will not retry the target function.
If it's not zero, the failure of target function will initiate correcting the spec by LLM.
And it keeps retrying the correction and executing the target function until executing successfully
or reaching either this retry max or the #retryTimeoutSec.

retryTimeoutSec.description:
When the retry was initiated, the agent will retry to execute and correct the spec until
executing successfully or reaching either the #retryMax or this timeout.

NOTE: this time does not include the initial attempt.

promptTemplateReflexionAgent.description: The prompt used to correct the eval spec during the retry process.

llmModelNameReflexionAgent.description: The LLM model used to answer the question. Must correspond to a {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.ModelConfig}.
